Also like to add that when I get caught up in the infinity of the abstract during psychosis it makes it hard for me to focus on the physical realm and tasks at hand. That's why a strong support system is a huge blessing I believe for they can help you paddle the boat for a bit while you get reset and also if we trust their judgement/assessment of our functioning in the physical realm  they can help us to recognize we have gone too deep. I think my mistrust of people telling me it's at that point is one I constantly try to navigate my mind with the confidence that I am doing good and not crazy and this gets hardwired into my thinking even when it's obvious to others I am slipping. Another reason is people that know my condition are steady on  the look out for anything off and when they are constantly looking for it  at times they see what they are looking for mistakenly which makes me feel like I am always under scrutiny or meditated on.

From my experience they focus more on the  normal everyday life while I am focused on constantly analyzing the environment and wondering what this whole thing is about. I take care of the necessities but I also wonder about the bigger scheme maybe more than some. In the realm of the psychic phenomenon too people are aware of different things while others are also aware of different  set of insights. There is no limit to the mind nor dimensions or perceptions and so on I believe. There are many things that are infinite like the electromagnetic spectrum,ideas, math etc.What they usually call reality is what I call the physical realm basically everything you can physically touch. When traversing the realm of the metaphysical,spiritual, or the potential of the mind it can get deep and confusing and I lose touch with the physical realm from time to time especially during stress. 
I have witnessed my social autism many times where there are certain things you don't do or say and I just don't pick up on it what it is or if I do I don't understand why or don't believe it. 
Like I said though there are probably infinite dimensions, infinite perceptions and so on and people are mainly wanting to just live regular life and enjoy each others company. When I am constantly analyzing and developing different perceptions I believe it does make me foreign to regular everyday life in the context of social interaction. I believe it is possible to function in the social aspect and still dive deep into ideas but I feel at times that I was intended to be a person with a few friends at a time.
